title: 第十七章 你这怎么可能第十八章 难道是他错了
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
“不就是种草药吗？你们不用担心。”
叶晚秋本人还是挺乐观的，反正她在门派里也没有什么事情。
药尘子没有把她赶下山，还愿意给她一个弥补的机会，叶晚秋已经很感激了。
可偏偏其他几人听到这话更愁了。
崔向阳端着碗，觉得美味的面条此刻都少了几分味道。
“叶婆婆，你不懂，这种草药和种地不一样，就比如咱们之前吃的那些，是药尘子长老从其他地方寻来的种子，很是难得，三年才长那么大，要是等开花结果，不知道要多久……”
夏景景呼出一口气：“婆婆你放心，如果我平时没事的话，一定会去帮你的！”
“不用不用，”叶晚秋摆摆手，那她就看看这药草有什么不同。
第二天一早，叶晚秋吃过早饭后，立马前往药草园。
再次来到药园，叶晚秋看了一圈，得出的结论依旧是和菜园没有什么区别。
她喊了几声，也没见药尘子从屋里出来，估计是还生气呢。
叶晚秋看了一圈，找到把锄头，既然要重新开始种草药，得先开垦一块地出来吧？
只是这山上全是碎石子，看着是泥土的地方一铲子下去都是硬邦邦的石头。
叶晚秋几锄头下去，都快要冒火星了。
难怪崔向阳几人说这草药不好种，这里连土都没有，怎么可能种的出来，还没自己院子里的土多呢。
她决定还是先给剩下的草药浇浇水，至于新的种子要怎么种，等药尘子出来再说。
药园里有个大水缸，叶晚秋拿起水瓢，给剩下的药草浇水。
虽然这些药草是被她拔了一些，但都是挑着种的密的地方拔的，药园里还剩下很多。
淋了水的药草看起来绿油油的，叶晚秋忍不住想，要是包大包子肯定好吃……
[系统友情提示，按照宿主的种法，这些草药这辈子也不会开花结果的。]

系统突然冒出来，把叶晚秋吓了一跳。
她捂住自己的心口，“系统啊，你知道我年龄大了，实在是经不住吓，下次出来的时候能不能提前说一声。”
[……好的宿主。]
叶晚秋想起它刚才说的话，问：“你说我这种种植方法不对？那要怎么种？”
[宿主稍等，系统查询中……]
[赤凰草，传闻乃上古凤凰精血洒落人间所化，其种子细如尘埃，呈暗红色，花如凤凰展翅，果子火红，果皮有细微羽毛纹路。
千棵赤凰草中仅有两三棵侥幸结果，故极其珍贵。灵脉受损、身有隐疾的修士服下赤凰草，便可重塑灵脉。]
叶晚秋明白了，难怪药尘子这么生气。
虽然她拔的不多，但万一拔的就是那一棵可以开花结果的赤凰草呢。
“系统，那有没有办法可以让这个赤凰草结果的概率大一些呢？”
[考虑到宿主没有灵力，可用高温催芽，比如热水煮制、烈火炙烤等。]
不愧是神药啊，想要发催芽还要烤，如果是其他东西，煮一下全熟了……
就在叶晚秋看得津津有味时，不远处屋子的门打开，药尘子打着哈欠走出来。
当看到叶晚秋时，他的那点瞌睡被吓到消散了个干干净净。
“你你你！你怎么在这里？”
content_en:
"Isn't it just about growing herbs? You don't have to worry."
Ye Wanqiu herself is quite optimistic. Anyway, she has nothing to do in the sect.
Ye Wanqiu was already very grateful that Yao Chenzi did not drive her down the mountain and was willing to give her a chance to make amends.
But several other people became even more worried when they heard this.
Cui Xiangyang held the bowl and felt that the delicious noodles had lost a bit of flavor at the moment.
"Grandma Ye, you don't understand. This kind of herbal medicine is different from farming. Just like the ones we ate before, they are seeds that Elder Yaochenzi found from other places. They are very rare. It takes three years to grow so big. If you wait for them to bloom and bear fruit, I don't know how long it will take..."
Xia Jingjing exhaled: "Don't worry, mother-in-law, if I'm fine, I will definitely help you!"
"No, no, no," Ye Wanqiu waved her hand, then she would see the difference in this herb.
Early the next morning, after Ye Wanqiu had breakfast, he immediately went to the herb garden.
When Ye Wanqiu came to the medicine garden again, he looked around and concluded that it was still no different from the vegetable garden.
She shouted several times, but Yao Chenzi didn't come out of the house. She was probably still angry.
Ye Wanqiu looked around and found a hoe. Since he wanted to start planting herbs again, he had to clear a piece of land first, right?
It's just that the mountain is full of gravel. Where it looks like dirt, you can shovel down hard rocks.
Every time Ye Wanqiu hoeed, sparks were almost coming out.
No wonder Cui Xiangyang and others said that it was difficult to grow this herb. There was no soil here, so how could they grow it? There was not as much soil as in their own yard.
She decided to water the remaining herbs first. As for how to plant new seeds, she would wait until Yaochenzi came out.
There was a large water tank in the medicine garden. Ye Wanqiu picked up the water ladle and watered the remaining herbs.
Although she had pulled some of these herbs, they were all picked from densely planted areas, and there were still many left in the garden.
The herbs that were soaked in water looked green, and Ye Wanqiu couldn't help but think that it would be delicious if made into big buns...
[Friendly reminder from the system, according to the host’s planting method, these herbs will not bear fruit in this life. ]
The system suddenly appeared, startling Ye Wanqiu.
She covered her heart and said, "System, you know I'm getting older and I really can't stand the scare. Can you tell me in advance next time I come out?"
[...Good host. ]
Ye Wanqiu remembered what it had just said and asked, "You think my planting method is wrong? How should I plant it?"
[Host, wait a moment, the system is querying...]
[Red Phoenix Grass is rumored to be the result of ancient phoenix essence and blood spilled into the world. Its seeds are as fine as dust and dark red in color. The flowers are like phoenix wings spread. The fruit is fiery red and the peel has fine feather lines.
Only two or three of the thousand red phoenix grasses bear fruit by chance, so they are extremely precious. Monks with damaged spiritual veins or hidden illnesses can reshape their spiritual veins by taking red phoenix grass. ]
Ye Wanqiu understood, no wonder Yao Chenzi was so angry.
Although she didn't pull out much, what if she pulled out the red phoenix grass that could bloom and bear fruit?
"System, is there any way to increase the probability of the outcome of this red phoenix grass?"
[Considering that the host has no spiritual power, high temperature can be used to induce germination, such as boiling in hot water, roasting, etc. ]
It is indeed a magic medicine. If you want it to germinate, you have to bake it. If it is something else, boil it until it is fully cooked...
Just when Ye Wanqiu was watching with great interest, the door of the house not far away opened, and Yao Chenzi came out yawning.
When he saw Ye Wanqiu, his drowsiness was completely frightened away.
"You, you, you! Why are you here?"
